# Contributing to SUMIT KEY

This repository is owned and maintained by [@rock4007](https://github.com/rock4007).

## Requesting access

To contribute code, open an Issue with the title **"Access Request"** and include:

- Your GitHub username
- What you want to change and why
- Whether you need read-only or write access

The owner will review your request and grant collaborator access if approved.

## If you have been granted access

1. Fork or clone the repository
2. Create a branch: `git checkout -b your-feature`
3. Make your changes and push
4. Open a Pull Request — the owner must approve it before it can merge
5. All changes to every file require owner review (enforced via CODEOWNERS)

## What you cannot do without permission

- Push directly to `main`
- Merge any pull request without owner approval
- Modify CODEOWNERS, branch protection rules, or security settings
- Access private branches or internal configuration files
